name: Dynamic F - Valve integrity: leaking PMV (illustrative)
description: PMV-101 has a small seat leak (configured leak path 0.0001 mm2 Cd.A) and PWV-101 a slower actuator. Perform the PMV inflow test and PWV stroke test from the Integrity panel and interpret the results. All data ILLUSTRATIVE - acceptance limits are training values.
briefing: PMV inflow test: close PMV-101, let the cavity bleed to flowline pressure through PWV-101, close PWV-101, then start the 'PMV inflow' test.
The cavity pressure (PT-104) rises only if fluid crosses the closed PMV seat: C dP/dt = Q_leak + thermal expansion.
Stroke-test PWV-101 and compare the measured time with the 32 s datasheet value.
